name: SearchApi
summary: Structured results from Google (web, News, Maps, Shopping, Images, Videos, Scholar, Jobs, Trends, Autocomplete), Bing, YouTube and Amazon as JSON, one GET per engine.

api_key.description: a SearchApi API key (the dashboard at searchapi.io)

notes: Every engine is the same GET /api/v1/search with a different engine value; the engine's own parameters follow.
The key goes in the Authorization header as a Bearer token; the docs also accept it as an api_key query parameter, which this file does not use.
A bad key is HTTP 401 with {"error": "Invalid API key."} (called live on 2026-11-24).
Only successful searches, those answered with HTTP 200, are billed (pricing page).
Paging is by page number (1-based). Google phased out num in September 2025, so a Google web page holds at most 10 organic results and num is left out here; Bing pages with next_page_token.
A Google result that is a redirect carries a link_token instead of a final URL; the Google Resolve API turns it into the destination.
search_metadata.status is Success or Error, and search_metadata.json_url and html_url point at the stored copy of the response.

endpoints.name: Google search
endpoints.summary: Structured Google web results (organic, knowledge graph, answer box, AI overview, related searches and more) for a query.

q.description: The search query; operators such as site:, inurl:, intitle:, AND and OR work.

location.description: Canonical location of the search, as the Locations API names it; the most popular match wins. Cannot be combined with latitude and longitude.

latitude.description: Latitude of the search location in decimal degrees (-90 to 90); use with longitude, not with location.

longitude.description: Longitude of the search location in decimal degrees (-180 to 180); use with latitude, not with location.

gl.description: Two-letter country of the search; us by default. Inferred from the coordinates when latitude and longitude are set.

hl.description: Interface language of the search; en by default.

lr.description: Limit to documents in a language, as lang_ja; several joined with |.

cr.description: Limit to documents from a country, as countryFR; several joined with |.

safe.description: SafeSearch: active filters adult content, blur (default) blurs explicit images, off disables it.

time_period.description: Only results from the past period.

time_period_min.description: Start of a custom time period, as MM/DD/YYYY; works alone or with time_period_max.

time_period_max.description: End of a custom time period, as MM/DD/YYYY; works alone or with time_period_min.

verbatim.description: true makes Google use the exact keywords, with no spelling correction, synonyms or stemming.

nfpr.description: 1 excludes results from an auto-corrected query; 0 (default) includes them.

filter.description: 1 (default) enables the Duplicate Content and Host Crowding filters; 0 disables them.

device.description: Device to emulate; desktop by default.

notes: Each page holds at most 10 organic results (Google phased out num in September 2025); page=2 is results 11 to 20.
organic_results[] carries position, title, link, domain, displayed_link, snippet and source; a redirect result has a link_token for the Google Resolve API instead of its destination URL.

endpoints.name: Google News search
endpoints.summary: Google News articles for a query, with source, date and thumbnail.

q.description: The search query; operators such as site:, inurl: and intitle: work.

location.description: Canonical location of the search, as the Locations API names it.

gl.description: Two-letter country of the search; us by default.

hl.description: Interface language of the search; en by default.

time_period.description: Only articles from the past period.

time_period_min.description: Start of a custom time period, as MM/DD/YYYY.

time_period_max.description: End of a custom time period, as MM/DD/YYYY.

sort_by.description: most_recent sorts by date; the default is relevance.

notes: A site: operator makes Google answer with a Google Search page instead of Google News.

endpoints.name: Google Maps search
endpoints.summary: Places on Google Maps for a query, with address, rating, hours and coordinates.

q.description: What to look for, as typed into Maps.

ll.description: Where to apply the query: @latitude,longitude,zoom (12z) or @latitude,longitude,meters (500m).

endpoints.name: Google Shopping search
endpoints.summary: Products on Google Shopping for a query, with price, seller, rating and the filters Google offers.

q.description: The product query; filters written into it are hints, not strict filters.

gl.description: Two-letter country of the search; us by default. Prices come in its local currency.

location.description: Canonical location of the search, as the Locations API names it.

price_min.description: Lowest price to return, in the gl country's currency. Ignored when shoprs is set.

price_max.description: Highest price to return, in the gl country's currency. Ignored when shoprs is set.

is_small_business.description: true keeps only products sold by small businesses.

is_free_delivery.description: true keeps only products with free shipping.

sort_by.description: Order of the results; relevance by default.

shoprs.description: An encoded filter value from the filters block of an earlier response; it takes priority over the plain filters above.

endpoints.name: Google Images search
endpoints.summary: Images from Google Images for a query, with source page, dimensions and thumbnail.

q.description: The search query; operators such as site: and intitle: work.

gl.description: Two-letter country of the search; us by default.

size.description: Image size: large, medium, icon, or a larger_than_<width>x<height> or larger_than_<n>mp value from the docs.

time_period.description: Only images from the past period.

endpoints.name: Google Videos search
endpoints.summary: Videos from Google's video tab for a query, filtered by duration, quality, captions and source.

q.description: The search query; operators such as site: and intitle: work.

gl.description: Two-letter country of the search; us by default.

time_period.description: Only videos from the past period.

duration.description: short is under 4 minutes, medium 4 to 20, long over 20.

captioned.description: closed keeps only videos with closed captions.

source.description: Only videos from one source, such as youtube, ted or tiktok (the docs list the accepted values).

endpoints.name: Google Scholar search
endpoints.summary: Scholarly articles on Google Scholar for a query, or the papers citing or versioning a given article, with authors, publication and citation counts.

q.description: The search query; operators such as author: and source: work. Not needed when cites or cluster is given.

cites.description: An article id; returns the documents that cite it.

cluster.description: An article id; returns the versions of that article. Takes priority over q.

scisbd.description: 0 (default) sorts by relevance; 1 keeps abstracts only, from the last year, by date; 2 keeps the last year, by date.

as_rr.description: 1 keeps only review articles; 0 (default) keeps everything.

as_sdt.description: Patent filter: 0 (default) excludes patents, 7 includes them; the docs list the US case-law values.

num.description: Results per page, 10 by default and at most 20.

endpoints.name: Google Jobs search
endpoints.summary: Job postings from Google Jobs for a query, with company, location, posting date and apply links.

q.description: The job query; a place in the text narrows it (software engineer jobs in San Francisco).

location.description: Canonical location of the search, as the Locations API names it; cannot be combined with latitude and longitude.

latitude.description: Latitude of the search location in decimal degrees; use with longitude, not with location.

longitude.description: Longitude of the search location in decimal degrees; use with latitude, not with location.

gl.description: Two-letter country of the search; follows location, else us.

hl.description: Interface language; follows the gl country by default.

next_page_token.description: The next_page_token of the previous response, to fetch the page after it.

notes: Paging is by next_page_token from the previous response, not by page number.

endpoints.name: Google Trends
endpoints.summary: Google Trends data for up to five terms: interest over time, interest by region, or related topics and queries.

q.description: Up to five terms separated by commas. Required unless data_type is TIMESERIES with a non-zero cat.

data_type.description: TIMESERIES is interest over time, GEO_MAP interest by region, RELATED_TOPICS and RELATED_QUERIES the related lists.

geo.description: Geographical scope, as a Trends geo code; worldwide when unset.

region.description: Granularity of a GEO_MAP: COUNTRY (worldwide only), REGION, DMA or CITY.

time.description: Time range as Trends writes it: now 1-H, now 7-d, today 1-m, today 12-m, today 5-y, all, or two dates as YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD.

cat.description: Trends category id; 0 (default) is all categories.

gprop.description: Search property: unset for web search, images, news, froogle (Shopping) or youtube.

tz.description: Timezone offset in minutes from UTC, -1439 to 1439; 420 by default.

endpoints.name: Google Autocomplete
endpoints.summary: The suggestions Google's search box offers for a partial query.

q.description: The partial query, up to 100 characters.

cp.description: Cursor position within q; 0 is the start, unset is the end.

client.description: The client the request pretends to come from (chrome, say); it changes the shape of the suggestions.

gl.description: Two-letter country of the search; us by default.

endpoints.name: Bing search
endpoints.summary: Structured Bing web results (organic, related searches and more) for a query.

q.description: The search query; operators such as site:, feed:, AND and OR work.

location.description: Canonical location of the search, as the Locations API names it.

market_code.description: Market as language-country, such as en-US; cannot be combined with country_code.

country_code.description: Two-letter country when market_code is not set; US by default.

language.description: Interface language, as a 2-letter or language-region code; en by default.

time_period.description: Only results from the past period.

time_period_min.description: Start of a custom time period, as MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD.

time_period_max.description: End of a custom time period, as MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD.

device.description: Device to emulate; desktop by default.

page.description: Page of results, starting at 1; page=2 always starts at result 11.

next_page_token.description: pagination.next_page_token from the previous response; continues right after its last organic result.

notes: Bing's first page can hold fewer than 10 organic results, so page=2 may skip some; next_page_token continues exactly where the last response ended.
num has no effect on Bing any more and is left out.

endpoints.name: YouTube search
endpoints.summary: Videos, channels, playlists and shorts from YouTube search for a query.

q.description: What to search for on YouTube.

sp.description: YouTube's encoded filter and paging value: a filter such as CAI (recently uploaded), or the next-page token from the previous response.

gl.description: Two-letter country of the search; us by default.

notes: Paging goes through sp: send the next-page value from the previous response as sp.

endpoints.name: Amazon search
endpoints.summary: Products from an Amazon marketplace's search for a query, with price, rating, Prime status and sponsored flags.

q.description: What to search for on Amazon.

amazon_domain.description: The marketplace; amazon.com by default (the docs list the supported domains).

language.description: Display language of the Amazon page, from the domain's supported list.

currency.description: Currency of the displayed prices (EUR, say), where the domain supports it.

postal_code.description: Delivery postal code for postal-code countries; search_metadata.delivery_location says whether it was applied.

delivery_country.description: Two-letter country of the delivery address; the domain's country by default.

category_id.description: An Amazon browse node id that limits results to one category.

rh.description: Amazon's own refinement string, as found in an Amazon URL or an earlier response (brand, rating, price range).

sort_by.description: Order of the results; featured by default.

price_min.description: Lowest price to return, in the marketplace's own currency even when currency is set.

price_max.description: Highest price to return, in the marketplace's own currency even when currency is set.
